    Get node info

    Source: R/nodeStats.R
    node_stats.Rd

    Creates node statistics Generates Number of Passenger Arrivals, Departures and Transfers

    Usage

    node_stats(x)

    Arguments

    x

    Data Frame to extract information from

    Value

    A data frame with one row per airport: airport (IATA code), pass_dep (departing passengers), pass_arr (arriving passengers), pass_tr (transfer passengers, 0 when the data has no trip_break column), the airport information from airportCodeFull (city, coordinates, state, country, ...) and freq (arrivals plus departures minus transfers).

    Examples

    node_stats(OD_Sample)
